Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/confirmation-visible/ledger/solution.py`.

It selects the latest event per exact key by highest revision, breaking ties by last payload order, emits winning puts in `live`, and emits winning deletes in `deleted` only when `config["include_deleted"]` is true. Both lists are sorted by key using normal Python string ordering.
